name: Shabu-shabu
description: Paper-thin meat swished through plain kombu broth for seconds, then dipped.

tcm.note: Meat cooked seconds in a plain kelp broth — the lightest hotpot.

ayurveda.note: Ushna from the mamsa; the broth adds nothing.

histamine.note: The broth is only kombu, so this is far lower than a soy or miso hotpot — the dipping sauces decide it.
